rows.grounds: locative of compound ṣaṭ-cakra indicating locus of practice
fused form containing optative of jap and accusative manum; mantra to be recited

items.question: What ritual action follows momentary meditation within the six-chakra?
premises: The six-chakra is the locus of practice.
Meditation is performed for a moment.
items.inference: After briefly meditating in the six-chakra, one should chant the mantra.
uncertainties: The specific mantra referred to by manum is not identified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O supreme lady, having meditated for a moment in the six-chakra, one should chant the mantra.
